versions.changelog: Adds evidence-backed wisdom distillation, 22 verified Phase 5-9 cards, bounded one-primary/one-support routing, executable routing acceptance cases, and safer local-only installation guidance.
Adds 33 behavior cards across Discover, Validate, Plan, Track, and cross-stage guidance, plus the card index, routing instructions, distillation guide, planning blueprint, and completion summary.

Adds bilingual guidance, hardened install paths, lifecycle transitions and recovery, one-click installation, project-design pattern cards, project archetypes, and ADR planning support. Expands regression coverage to 39 tests.
Initial public v0.1 release. Feedback is very welcome.
